metadata.description: Cowork-first starter scaffolding: process discipline, knowledge management, delegation patterns, and a personal-companion track. Distributed as zips attached to GitHub releases — install via Cowork's Customize → Browse plugins → upload custom plugin file. Works for any kind of structured work, not just coding.

plugins.name: welcome
plugins.description: Top-level marketplace orientation. One slash command (/welcome:tour) plus a value-first opening that names three concrete user moments (decide / reflect / fintech triage) and invites the user into theirs, in any language. No upfront feature list; catalog only on request. Read-only — writes nothing, invokes nothing without consent. Recommended first install for new users.

plugins.name: process-skills
plugins.description: Six domain-agnostic process skills: brainstorming (idea → validated design), planning-projects (staged plan with gates), executing-plans (drive a plan to done with evidence-of-done), evidence-first-investigation (figure out why before proposing what), review-document (holistic 30-second-rule review), peer-review-deliverable (review what's new against a baseline). Plus /process-skills:tour for the read-only walkthrough.

plugins.name: vault-librarian
plugins.description: Companion to the upstream obsidian-wiki plugin. One cross-platform slash command (/vault-librarian:bootstrap-vault) that sets up a Markdown notes vault from inside Claude Code, with persona-tuned schema templates for researchers, writers, generalists, and personal users. No shell snippets — works on Claude Code Desktop and Claude Cowork on macOS and Windows.

plugins.name: delegation-agents
plugins.description: Three model-pinned worker subagents (bulk-reader on Haiku, document-rewriter and draft-generator on Sonnet) plus a dispatching-parallel-agents skill. Lets a parent session on Opus offload bulk reading, editing, and drafting to cheaper, faster models. Domain-agnostic — works for research, writing, project management, analysis.

plugins.name: personal-coach
plugins.description: Personal-use companion: persistent profile across sessions, CBT-style reflection (not therapy), business-decision frames with grading, fintech legal-issue spotter for KYC/AML/MiCA/GDPR (not legal advice), and a personalized daily news digest. Value-first onboarding — one short opening, then engages a real situation. Auto-bootstraps its own notes vault on first save (no separate command needed). Multilingual. Hard limits enforced.
